Overview

South Bend is a city in IN with a population of 103,000. Home of the University of Notre Dame with a revitalized downtown and Studebaker history. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.9.
